title: Keep data in an object
summary: PHP: Keep data in an object. Change the object colour to red.
introduction: A class is a plan for objects. Each object can have its own stored fields.
learningObjectives: Keep data in an object with PHP
Change the object colour to red

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.

blocks.title: Keep data in an object
blocks.code:
<?php
class Badge { public string $colour = "blue"; }
$badge = new Badge();
echo $badge->colour;

blocks.text: new Badge creates an object. The arrow reads its colour field, which starts as blue.
Change the object colour to red.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use -> to read a field on an object, not array brackets.
